title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tackles the Standard Model's toughest math problem on a lattice
snippet: OpenAI physicist Nathaniel Craig used GPT-6 Astra to tackle a problem that had stumped particle physicists for over 25 years. Craig says a lot of work remains before realistic simulations are possible.
